pattern: ^SELECT .+ FROM ([A-Za-z0-9]+) JOIN ([A-Za-z0-9]+) ON ([A-Za-z0-9]+).([A-Za-z0-9]+)_id = ([A-Za-z0-9]+).address_id WHERE ([A-Za-z0-9]+).state_province_county = '(.*)' AND ([A-Za-z0-9]+).student_id NOT IN \(\s*SELECT\s+student_id\s+FROM\s+Student_Enrolment\s*\)

metadata.description: The query uses an incorrect method for excluding enrolled students. It should perform a separate join with the Student_Enrolment table instead.
